Name: Normal skin Willy
Author: bluestarkiller
Description:
This is a small mod that fixes Willy's skin tone on his overworld sprite so he no longer looks like a character from the Simpsons. Because apparently he went fishing to Springfield during Spring 1 and that is why he wasn't there on your first day.

As usual, just unzip, and drop it on your Contents folder to replace the game sprite.

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
